page_title: NOT 2-3 NEW | Nottingham Forest v Newcastle 10/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+7' Nuno Tavares (Nottingham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
90+5' The attendance for today's match is 29451.
90+4' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) is booked by the referee.
90+4' Newcastle take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+2' The referee signals a substitution. Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) is brought on as a substitute for Anthony Gordon.
90+2' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
89' Dangerous play by Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham). Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
87' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

85' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Nottingham are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
81' A substitution has been made. Lewis Miley goes off and Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) comes on.
80' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) brings an opponent down and Anthony Taylor interrupts the game. Nottingham are awarded the free kick.
80' Neco Williams (Nottingham) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
79' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
79' Giovanni Reyna (Nottingham) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Danilo (Nottingham) is coming onto the pitch as Nicolas Dominguez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
78' Martin Dubravka displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Divock Origi (Nottingham) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
77' Moussa Niakhate (Nottingham) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
76' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

76' Divock Origi (Nottingham) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Nottingham.
73' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to make a change. Giovanni Reyna (Nottingham) replaces Ryan Yates.

73' Nuno Tavares (Nottingham) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
68' Taiwo Awoniyi goes off the pitch and Divock Origi (Nottingham) comes on.
66' 2 - 3 Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) doesn't hesitate to lash home from just outside the box. He hits the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and it nestles in the net.
64' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
64' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Nottingham! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Anthony Taylor and both teams have no complaints.

63' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Nottingham.
62' PENALTY APPEAL after Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
60' Substitution. Miguel Almiron will be replaced by Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd).
59' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is yellow-carded.
59' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is flagged for offside.
58' Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) picked up a yellow card from referee.
58' Neco Williams (Nottingham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
58' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the corner but it's cleared.
57' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) works the corner short.
56' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
53' Nuno Tavares (Nottingham) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
50' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
47' Nuno Tavares (Nottingham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+7' Anthony Taylor has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+6' 2 - 2 Goal! Nicolas Dominguez passes the ball to Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Martin Dubravka couldn't do anything about it. 2:2.
45+2' Moussa Niakhate (Nottingham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Martin Dubravka intercepts the ball.
45+2' Moussa Niakhate (Nottingham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

43' 1 - 2 GOAL! Sven Botman jumps high to meet the resulting free kick and nods the ball into the path of Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd), who is unmarked inside the box and slots the ball into the back of the net. It's 1:2.
42' The corner from Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is intercepted by Martin Dubravka.

42' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball goes out for a corner. Nottingham can continue in their attacking effort.
41' Newcastle seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
40' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) brings his opponent down. Anthony Taylor has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Neco Williams (Nottingham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
36' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
34' Good clearance! Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
30' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
29' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 27:73.
26' 1 - 1 GOAL! Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) runs onto a pass from Morgan Gibbs-White after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from mid range. It’s now 1:1.
25' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
20' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
17' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
16' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
15' Wonderful movement by Newcastle. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
14' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Anthony Taylor has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
12' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
10' 0 - 1 Goal! Kieran Trippier puts a cross into the box and finds Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd), who latches on to it and strikes the ball inside the right post. He makes it 0:1.
10' Newcastle take a short corner kick.
9' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

9' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Matz Sels! The referee points to the corner flag and Newcastle will take a corner.

5' Nuno Tavares pulls the ball back to Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) inside the box, but despite having a clear sight of goal he blasts the ball just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
4' Murillo (Nottingham) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Anthony Taylor saw the whole situation.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Newcastle will have the kick-off.
Anthony Taylor is the one to supervise the game today.
